description: This file defines a singleton class AgentEventStore that manages a list of ControlAgentEvent objects, providing methods to append new events and clear the event list. It is likely used to store and manage event data within an application, specifically for the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: AgentEventStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages agent events, with thread-safe access facilitated by @MainActor and @Observable.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new ControlAgentEvent to the event list and ensures the list size does not exceed maxEvents.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all events from the event list.
